test_basic_feature_value: test that feature=value command line syntax works in Boost.Build Jam scripts
test_implicit_features: test that implicit features can be named without a feature prefix on the command line
test_optional_features: test that feature= syntax works for optional features in Boost.Build
test_free_features: test that free features apply to all targets and accept special characters
test_subfeature_syntax: test that subfeatures are expressed as feature=value-subvalue on the command line
test_multiple_values_comma: test that multiple feature values can be given in a comma-separated list
test_multiple_properties_slash: test that multiple properties can be grouped with a forward slash separator
test_cross_product_expansion: test that multiple properties expand to every possible maximum set of non-conflicting features
